description: Public holidays for a country and year, with status (rule / confirmed / estimated / observed / bridge) and sources. Islamic holidays are estimated until a reviewer has verified the announcement (delays are possible).

description.name: get_holiday_watch
description.description: Across countries: holidays whose date depends on an announcement (Eid, Mawlid and other moon-sighted holidays, ad-hoc days off) from a week ago to N days ahead, with status estimated (not announced or not yet verified) or confirmed (with its source), and who announces them (Developer, Essentials, Pr

description.name: get_changes
description.description: The change log: one entry per changed value, oldest first, with the old and new value, kind (law_change, correction, new_source, coverage), the date a law change applies from, and its source. Optional: since (YYYY-MM-DD) and one country. Developer, Essentials and Pro plans: holiday changes; Complian

description.name: is_business_day
description.description: Whether a date is a working day in a country (weekend and national public holidays).

description.name: count_business_days
description.description: Number of working days between two dates (inclusive) in a country, and the holidays skipped.

description.name: add_business_days
description.description: Date that is N working days after (or before, if negative) a start date in a country.

description.name: get_vat
description.description: VAT/GST/TVA/IVA standard and other rates, registration threshold and legal basis for a country. With 'date', also the standard rate in force on that date (dated history with the law that set it).

description.name: get_vat_history
description.description: Every standard VAT rate period for a country (from, to, rate) with the law that set it, for audits, refunds and re-invoicing.

description.name: get_withholding_tax
description.description: Withholding tax rates (resident / non-resident) by payment type: dividends, interest, royalties, rent, services, fees... With 'recipient_country', also the tax-treaty maximum rates for a payment to that country.

description.name: calculate_withholding_tax
description.description: The tax to withhold on one payment from a country to a recipient resident in another country (or the same one): applies the domestic rate and, for a non-resident, the tax-treaty maximum (the lower one), and returns the rate, the amount withheld and the net payment, with the sources. With amount_is '

description.name: get_tax_treaties
description.description: Double tax treaties of a country (as the paying country): maximum withholding rates on dividends, interest, royalties and technical fees for each treaty partner, with conditions, dates in force and the official text.

description.name: get_einvoicing
description.description: A country's e-invoicing or fiscalisation requirement: system (e.g. eTIMS, EFRIS, MBS), tax authority, status (mandatory, phased, voluntary, pilot, planned, unclear, none_found), model (clearance, real-time reporting, fiscal device), dated phases (who must comply from when), legal basis and source, a

description.name: get_finance_law_changes
description.description: Plain-English digest of a country's latest finance law: business-relevant tax changes (VAT, withholding, corporate, payroll, procedure) with effective dates and article references. Unofficial summary; the cited law prevails (Compliance plan).

description.name: get_payroll_tax
description.description: Income tax bands on employment income for resident employees (PAYE / ITS / IRPP...): the bands, tax-free threshold and reliefs in force on a date (default today), and every dated period with its legal basis, source and confidence. Reference data only, no salary calculation.

description.name: get_social_security
description.description: Statutory contributions on pay (pension, social security, health, housing, work injury, training and other payroll levies): employee and employer rates, base, floor and ceiling in force on a date (default today), and every dated period with its legal basis, source and confidence.

description.name: validate_tax_id_format
description.description: Check whether a taxpayer identification number matches the country's known format. Format check only: it does not confirm registration (format_check 'partial' means a weak check on characters and length only). The number is not stored.

description.name: get_filing_deadlines
description.description: Tax filing and payment due dates falling in a given month (VAT, PAYE, withholding, corporate tax), adjusted for weekends and holidays where the country's rule (weekend_adjust) or the item's own rule is known; otherwise the statutory date with adjusted: false.

description.name: get_country_profile
description.description: All compliance reference data for one country: holiday rules, announcement authority, VAT, withholding tax, tax ID format, filing deadlines and sources (tax parts on the Compliance plan, and on Essentials and Pro for the countries of their country pack).
